title: 第19章 房屋建设中第20章 猎杀妖兔
slug: 我在民俗世界打造洞天福地
content_zh:
;;
吃过饭后。
沈易绕着他们家的院子转了一圈。
院子占地足有三百平左右。
石墙是一堵两米高的青石墙。
材质坚硬，是从黑山搬下来的。
不过鉴于这段时间没人修缮，石墙已经出现了不少窟窿。
甚至有几处已经塌陷，灵纹黯淡，墙面上生出一层薄薄的苔藓植物。
这几天精怪的冲击，已经让石墙的耐久接近清零了。
沈易看着眼前的围墙沉思着。
如果将［泥沼地］设置在外面，估计没多久就会被村里的人注意到。
只能是暂时设置在院子里面了。
反正他制作出来的东西随时都能够拆除，不用担心后续会有空间占用上的问题。
而且就将泥沼地设置在院子大门处。
到时候他升级围墙，让精怪只能从院子大门进入。
这样一来凡是进入他们家的精怪，立即便会陷入进泥沼地，成为他们兄妹三人的盘中餐！
沈易粗略丈量了一下。
后院面积大概160平方。
两片菜地的面积占了大半，每块菜地60平方左右，还设置着一个鸡舍。
而前院木屋大概五十平左右，院落空阔处则是一百平。

从院子大门到屋子的距离，约莫是十米。
“太小了。”
沈易摇头。
他需要大一点的地方。
而且他们兄妹三人挤在一个木屋里生活，没有隐私空间，也不是个事。
不过眼下没办法过多折腾。
只能是等日后发展起来后，再考虑扩建的事情。
眼下，他需要将自家院子打造成一座坚不可摧的防御堡垒！
在确保精怪无法攻破的情况下，还能够对精怪进行收割。
在确定要打造出一座坚固的基地后，沈易的思路一发不可收拾。
就是不知道他目前303根阴魂木够不够……
沈易随即沉下心思。
意念落在【围墙】上，投入一根阴魂木！
嗡！
【围墙·0级（升级中（1100）】
【功能：阻挡精怪袭击】
【特性：无】
【耐久值：4100】
……
“要这么多阴魂木？”

沈易以为最多就只需要花费50根阴魂木。
不过转念一想。
他们家的围墙可是圈起了三百平的土地，需要一百根阴魂木倒也不算夸张。
“大哥，你在做什么？”
此时。

After a meal.
Shen Yi walked around their yard.
The yard covers an area of ​​about 300 square meters.
The stone wall is a two-meter-high bluestone wall.
The material is hard and brought from Montenegro.
However, given that no one has repaired it during this period, many holes have appeared in the stone wall.
Some places have even collapsed, the spiritual patterns are dim, and a thin layer of moss has grown on the walls.
The impact of monsters in the past few days has nearly reduced the durability of the stone wall to zero.
Shen Yi looked at the wall in front of him and thought deeply.
If [the swamp] is set up outside, it will probably be noticed by the people in the village soon.
It can only be temporarily set up in the yard.
Anyway, what he made can be dismantled at any time, so there is no need to worry about subsequent space occupation problems.
And just set the swamp at the gate of the yard.
When the time comes, he upgrades the fence so that the spirits can only enter through the courtyard gate.
In this way, any spirit that enters their home will immediately fall into the quagmire and become a meal for the three brothers and sisters!
Shen Yi took a rough measurement.
The backyard area is about 160 square meters.
Two vegetable fields account for most of the area, each about 60 square meters, and there is also a chicken coop.
The wooden house in the front yard is about fifty square meters, and the spacious courtyard is one hundred square meters.
The distance from the courtyard gate to the house is about ten meters.
"Too small."
Shen Yi shook his head.
He needs a bigger place.
Moreover, it is not a problem for the three of them to live together in a wooden house with no privacy.
But there's no way to fuss too much right now.
We can only consider expansion after it develops in the future.
Right now, he needs to turn his yard into an impenetrable defensive fortress!
While ensuring that the spirits cannot be breached, the spirits can also be harvested.
After deciding to build a solid base, Shen Yi's thoughts got out of hand.
I just don’t know if his current 303 Haunted Soul Woods are enough...
Shen Yi immediately calmed down.
His thoughts fell on the [Wall] and he threw in a piece of Haunted Soul Wood!
Buzz!
[Fence·Level 0 (upgrading (1100)]
[Function: Block monster attacks]
[Characteristics: None]
[Durability value: 4100]
…
"You want so much Yinhunmu?"
Shen Yi thought that he would only need to spend 50 pieces of Haunted Soul Wood at most.
But then I thought about it.
Their family's wall encircles 300 square meters of land, so it's not an exaggeration to need a hundred Haunted Soul Woods.
"Brother, what are you doing?"
At this time.
